title: Jeonse Deposit Exit Kit
oneLiner: A renter proof kit that helps Korean tenants assemble fixed-date, HUG, landlord, registry, and move-out evidence before their deposit is at risk.
label: Practical / Commercial
targetUser: Korean tenants and foreign residents approaching lease end, especially first-time jeonse or ban-jeonse renters worried about deposit return.
keyUX: Tenant follows a dated evidence checklist, uploads registry and landlord messages, then receives a move-out proof packet and escalation calendar.

sourceSignals.source: KDI / Korea Times / tenant guides on jeonse deposit protection
sourceSignals.signal: Korean jeonse fraud and deposit-return risk remain a structural tenant problem; official and tenant guides emphasize fixed date, registration, and HUG guarantee steps.

spreadTrigger: A renter can forward the packet to family, a realtor, HUG, or a legal consultation without sounding scattered.
stitchPrompt: Build a production-grade web app prototype called "Jeonse Deposit Exit Kit" for Korean tenants and foreign residents preparing to recover a large rental deposit. The first screen must be a working proof kit with deposit risk countdown, fixed-date/address registration checklist, registry and lien snapshot tray, landlord message timeline, HUG guarantee stepper, move-out inspection drawer, and escalation letter packet. Use realistic sample data: KRW 180M jeonse deposit, lease ending in 47 days, fixed date complete, landlord delay message, registry update needed, HUG question, and move-out photo checklist. Design direction: use the calm-consumer profile with reassuring legal-adjacent guidance, low-stress warm neutrals, plain-language recovery states, and one gentle action accent for packet completion. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
